item.text: {"analysis":"The history-aware negative-filtering trial succeeded with host macro validation HR@10=0.5637: Movies_and_TV 0.6100, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.6000, Electronics 0.4350, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.6100. This improves on the reported consistency baseline of 0.5575 by 0.0062, but remains 0.0163 below the reported best of 0.5800. The result supports excluding known training interactions from sampled negatives, although one trial does not establish causality. Electronics remains the weakest category. No test metrics were available.","code_summary":"One independent MaskedSASRec model per category: 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, learned positions, two bidirectional pre-norm Transformer blocks with two heads, GELU output projection, and jointly trained item biases. Training combines final masked-query prediction and historical masked reconstruction with equal supervised weights, plus detached clean-to-corrupted KL consistency at temperature 2 and coefficient 0.1. The objective uses 256 shared uniform negatives, masking target collisions and every item in the corresponding user's complete training history. Sparse row/item metadata supplies exclusions without entering the encoder; auxiliary queries and consistency logits use aligned exclusions. AdamW, existing sampling, seeds, architecture, and validation checkpoint selection are preserved. The predictor routes all four datasets and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category; code includes exclusion, finite-loss, and export-parity checks."}
